visualizationDefinition: Displays a weighted graph and highlights the edges selected for a minimum spanning tree.
source: Original visualization implementation for this repository.

solver.solverDefinition: Finds a minimum spanning tree by sorting edges by weight and adding each edge if it joins two different components.
solver.source: Kruskal, J. B. "On the shortest spanning subtree of a graph and the traveling salesman problem." Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society 7, no. 1 (1956): 48-50.
